spec.text: Image 1 is the man's model sheet, image 2 the woman's model sheet, image 3 a real photo of the red-brick arcade of Bopiliao Historic Block in Taipei, image 4 the approved art style. Recreate the arcade from image 3 (red-brick columns and arches, wooden shopfronts, terracotta floor tiles) in the warm matte clay and gouache storybook style of image 4, late afternoon, golden backlight streaming down the arcade. The SAME couple in their casual outfits walk side by side away from the camera along the arcade, softly backlit, her half-up princess hair and his backpack visible, full bodies about four heads tall, filling about 40 percent of the frame height. Cinematic 16:9. No readable text or signs, no extra people, no photorealism.
